title: Extract workspace pane destination routing and focused routing tests
outcome: Current-tree audit 2026-09-22: ui/src/workspace.ts is 3,699 lines and workspace.test.ts is 5,041. The pane destination policy is cohesive: resolveWorkspaceOpenTargetPaneId, resolveSessionOpenTargetPaneId, resolveViewerOpenTarget, resolveCanvasOpenTargetPaneId, remembered content/viewer targets, nearest-control-surface selection and pane destination predicates. Extract these pure routing helpers and their routing tests into a focused module while keeping public entry points stable. This is distinct from tm-rqd session-reference/reconciliation helpers and tm-m6r1.15 Work-tab reducer. Do not implement the placement-policy proposals in tm-wmpn as part of the move.
acceptance: Same selected pane, tab identity, remembered destinations and layout mutations for existing inputs. No new layout policy or persistence schema. Avoid circular imports by passing existing values through a narrow boundary, without broad signature redesign. Ownership header and unchanged routing test inventory; validate affected tests and full gate through maintained launcher.
